bTAItn.new_value: This app is still being worked on. Let it finish, then clone it.
bTAItn.old_value: This app is still being worked on. Let it finish, then remix it.

ekrwGo.new_value: I couldn’t clone this app. Try again?
ekrwGo.old_value: I couldn’t remix this app. Try again?

so1WC7.new_value: I just made this as a clone of another app. Look it over, tell me what it does, build my copy, and then suggest some ways to make it my own.
so1WC7.old_value: I just made this as a remix of another app. Look it over, tell me what it does, build my copy, and then suggest some ways to make it my own.

analysis.detailed_summary: 새 locale은 이전 Fork/Fork App 용어를 Remix/Remix App으로 바꾸고, 다른 앱의 remix 사본을 만든 뒤 동작을 검토하고 자신만의 방식으로 바꾸라고 설명합니다. 원본 앱 작업이 진행 중이면 완료될 때까지 기다려야 하며 실패 시 재시도 문구가 표시됩니다. Allow Remixing은 다른 사용자가 사본을 만들 수 있는지 제어하는 shared-project 설정으로 보이지만, 허용 대상의 정확한 범위는 공개 문자열만으로 확인되지 않습니다.
analysis.search_intent: Discord에서 ‘Allow Remixing’ 문구를 본 사용자가 이 기능이나 상태가 무엇이고 왜 표시됐는지 확인하려는 검색입니다.
analysis.source_context: 현재 Canary 앱 제작 locale에서 Remix, Remix App, remix 사본 설명, 작업 완료 대기, 실패 재시도, Allow Remixing이 함께 있고 이전 Fork 문구는 삭제 행으로 기록됐습니다.
analysis.summary: 기존 Discord 앱 프로젝트를 사본으로 만들어 자신만의 버전으로 수정하는 Remix와 허용 설정 문구입니다.
analysis.what_it_means: 원본을 직접 바꾸는 대신 별도 프로젝트 사본을 만들어 수정하는 동작이며, Allow Remixing은 그 사본 생성 가능 여부를 제어합니다.
analysis.what_to_do: 앱 작업이 아직 진행 중이면 완료될 때까지 기다린 뒤 Remix를 다시 선택하세요. 실패 문구가 나오면 같은 프로젝트 화면에서 재시도하고, 소유자는 공유 범위를 확인한 뒤 Allow Remixing을 설정하세요.
analysis.when_it_appears: 공유된 앱을 새 프로젝트 사본으로 가져오거나, 프로젝트 소유자가 remix 허용 상태를 설정할 때 나타날 수 있습니다.

analysis_en.detailed_summary: The new locale replaces Fork/Fork App wording with Remix/Remix App and describes reviewing a remix copy of another app before making it one's own. Active work must finish first, and a failure state asks the user to retry. Allow Remixing appears to control whether a shared project can be copied, although the strings do not establish the exact audience that receives permission.
analysis_en.search_intent: A visitor likely searched for “Allow Remixing” to identify the Discord feature or state and understand why it appeared.
analysis_en.source_context: The current Canary app-building locale groups Remix, Remix App, remix-copy guidance, wait-for-work, retry failure, and Allow Remixing while the former Fork wording appears only as deleted history rows.
analysis_en.summary: Copy for allowing Remixing and making a customizable project copy of an existing Discord app.
analysis_en.what_it_means: Remix creates a separate project copy to customize instead of editing the original, while Allow Remixing controls whether that copy action is available.
analysis_en.what_to_do: If app work is still running, wait for it to finish and choose Remix again. Retry from the same project surface after a failure, and project owners should review the sharing context before enabling Remixing.
analysis_en.when_it_appears: May appear while copying a shared app into a new project or when the project owner controls whether remix copies are allowed.

analysis_en.what_it_means: Remix creates a separate project copy to customize instead of editing the original, while Allow Remixing controls whether that copy action is available.
analysis_en.what_to_do: If app work is still running, wait for it to finish and choose Remix again. Retry from the same project surface after a failure, and project owners should review the sharing context before enabling Remixing.
analysis_en.when_it_appears: May appear while copying a shared app into a new project or when the project owner controls whether remix copies are allowed.
